text: I think the main reason is that phones do almost everything now. You can chat with friends, watch videos, pay for things and even work. Also, apps are designed to keep people interested, so it's hard to stop. I'd say it can be a problem, especially for teenagers, because they sometimes forget to sleep or do homework. It's all about finding a balance, really.

tips.en: The passive makes the explanation more objective and varies the grammar.
tips.kk: Ырықсыз етіс түсіндірмені объективті етіп, грамматиканы әртараптандырады.
tips.ru: Пассивный залог делает объяснение более объективным и разнообразит грамматику.
tips.example: apps are designed to keep people interested

tips.en: The spoken tag 'really' sounds natural and softens the conclusion.
tips.kk: Ауызекі «really» аяқтауы табиғи естіліп, қорытындыны жұмсартады.
tips.ru: Разговорное завершение «really» звучит естественно и смягчает вывод.
tips.example: It's all about finding a balance, really

note.en: avoiding too much or too little
A hedged way to give an opinion

questions.question: Why do so many people spend a lot of time on their phones?

text: In some jobs, probably yes. Factories already use robots because they can work all day without getting tired. But I doubt they will replace jobs that need creativity or kindness, like teachers or nurses. What's more likely is that people will have to learn new skills to work alongside machines. So rather than losing jobs, we might see jobs changing.

tips.en: 'But I doubt' introduces an objection and shows critical thinking.
tips.kk: «But I doubt» қарсылық білдіріп, сыни ойлауды көрсетеді.
tips.ru: «But I doubt» вводит возражение и показывает критическое мышление.
tips.example: But I doubt they will replace jobs that need creativity or kindness

tips.en: The 'What's more likely is that' cleft is a complex clause structure.
tips.kk: «What's more likely is that» құрылымы — күрделі бағыныңқы сөйлем.
tips.ru: Конструкция с «What's more likely is that» — это сложное придаточное предложение.
tips.example: What's more likely is that people will have to learn new skills to work alongside machines

note.en: a contrast structure with rather than

questions.question: Do you think robots will replace human workers in the future?

text: Well, the biggest danger is that criminals can steal your identity or your money. For instance, if you post your address and holiday plans, someone might break into your house. Another risk is that photos stay online forever, even if you delete them. To be safe, people should use strong passwords and think twice before they post anything. It's better to be safe than sorry.

tips.en: A concrete scenario shows how the danger actually happens.
tips.kk: Нақты жағдай қауіптің қалай көрінетінін көрсетеді.
tips.ru: Конкретный сценарий показывает, как именно опасность проявляется.
tips.example: For instance, if you post your address and holiday plans, someone might break into your house

tips.en: The advice at the end follows logically from the risks.
tips.kk: Соңғы кеңес аталған қауіптерден логикалы шығады.
tips.ru: Совет в конце логично вытекает из названных рисков.
tips.example: To be safe, people should use strong passwords and think twice before they post anything

questions.question: What are the dangers of sharing personal information online?

text: I imagine more people will work from home, because video calls are getting better every year. Offices might become smaller, and companies will save money. On the plus side, workers will save time on travelling. On the downside, some people may feel lonely without colleagues. So I suppose the key will be mixing home and office, which a lot of companies already do.

tips.en: 'I imagine' suits predictions: you suggest rather than assert.
tips.kk: «I imagine» болжамға лайық: сіз қатаң айтпай, жорамалдайсыз.
tips.ru: «I imagine» подходит для прогнозов: вы не утверждаете, а предполагаете.
tips.example: I imagine more people will work from home

tips.en: A plus–minus pair organises the answer and shows both sides.
tips.kk: Артықшылық–кемшілік жұбы жауапты құрылымдап, екі жағын көрсетеді.
tips.ru: Пара плюс–минус организует ответ и показывает обе стороны.
tips.example: On the downside, some people may feel lonely without colleagues
